topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I tell ye, it's no good sign, finding somethin' buried that no one can recall hidin'. My mind runs to dark thoughts, ill omens warnin' of worse to come. We've troubles enough, with the soil churned by winter's frost and the taxes weighin' heavier each year. What sane man puts faith in secrets buried, forgetting where? Saints preserve us, if it's not a trap laid by those who'd see our village fall. I'll have no part of it, no sir. Let them dig up their own past mistakes. We've our future to worry about, and it's grim enough as it stands.
